# Answer to question 3 The **space complexity** of the algorithm is *linear*, because we store one value per input element. ## Steps 1. Read the input 2. Sort it 3. Print the result - first point - second point - nested point | Algorithm | Time | Space | | --------- | ---------- | ----- | | Bubble | O(n^2) | O(1) | | Merge | O(n log n) | O(n) | ```python def total(values): return sum(v for v in values if v > 0) ``` See [the documentation](https://docs.dodona.be) for more, or Ctrl+C to stop.
